caseNameFull: Young v. Anderson, Secretary of Agriculture of the United States
attorneys: Robert M. Rieser and John Wattawa for petitioner. Acting Solicitor General Washington, Assistant Attorney General Bazelon, Roger P. Marquis and Fred W. Smith for respondents. Greek L. Rice, Attorney General of Mississippi, filed a brief for that State, as amicus curiae, in support of the petition.

opinions.text: Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia denied.
